title: 第6章 给你吃大白兔奶糖
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
此时，周香兰正风情万种的倚靠在小卖部柜台前，摇着一把扇子，远远看见火急火燎的李大壮，就笑盈盈的逗弄起他来。

    只可惜，现在的李大壮是真着急，没心情欣赏她的风骚：“香兰姐！快把你摩托三轮借我用用，我爸出事了，我得赶紧去镇上！”

    “你这傻小子说啥胡话呢？你爸早晨走的时候还好好的，能出啥事儿？你要是闲着没事儿干，就跟姐去屋里，陪姐做个游戏打发时间好不好？”

    周香兰本是嫁到杏花村来的，但她男人在外面找了小三，常年不回家，两年前干脆跟她离了婚，她从嫁过来就在村里开着小卖部，离婚了也无处可去，正好她前夫也不回老家，她就继续在这儿干着。

    不过离了婚的女人，总归是寂寞，尤其是最近，天一热，她丰腴的身体和一颗春心，都跟着躁动起来，每天夜里不自己动动手，压根就睡不着。

    这会儿她看着高大帅气，浑身冒着热气的李大壮，那股空虚和寂寞又冒了出来，烧的她大白天就快受不住了，香汗滴滴流淌，勾人的美眸，仿佛生出了透明的黏丝，粘在了李大壮的身上！

    “大壮，姐说真的，姐屋里有大白兔奶糖，你跟姐进屋，姐就给你……”

    周香兰实在忍不住了，哪怕李大壮是个傻子，也比她见过的别的男人都招人稀罕，她迫不及待拉着李大壮的手往里屋拽！

    李大壮却急的头顶都要冒火了：“香兰姐！现在不是说这个时候！我爸真的出事了，我得赶紧去镇上，你借我摩托三轮，我晚上回来还你，到时你想让我吃啥都行！”

    “真的吃啥都行？”周香兰忍不住幻想起某些画面，顿时浑身发软，情不自禁的靠向大壮宽厚的胸膛，丰满的娇躯，因为激动微微颤抖着，雪白的圆润，刺激着李大壮的胸口！

    李大壮着急的说：“香兰姐，只要你赶紧把三轮车钥匙给我，真的吃啥都行！”

    周香兰顿时嗔笑起来，语气暧昧的若有所指：“你这傻小子，虽然脑子不灵光，但这张嘴还挺招人稀罕的，又能说，又能吃……”

    李大壮无语了：“香兰姐，我脑子确实是好了，但我看你的脑子好像是骚坏了！”

    “你不借拉倒，我去别人家！”李大壮实在没时间跟周香兰扯这些黄磕，扭头就要走。

    周香兰这才意识到不对劲，李大壮着急的表情和眼神，好像跟正常人没啥两样，难道，他真不傻了？

Li Dazhuang couldn't help but take a few more glances...

There is no way, Cao Ping's posture is too gorgeous, and she is very beautiful. Although she is over thirty, she has never given birth to a child. She looks like she is in her late teens, and her body is very moist. What normal man can resist looking at her?

Wang Qiang noticed Li Dazhuang's eyes, and an idea flashed in his mind. He endured the pain in his back and climbed up, pulling Cao Ping aside. He briefly talked about what had just happened, and then whispered: "Honey, Divine Doctor Li is really not an ordinary person, but now that I have completely offended him, I can only rely on you to win his forgiveness!"

"Rely on me? I'm not the same as others, how can I get forgiveness?" Cao Ping said angrily: "If you had listened to me earlier, maybe Dr. Li would have cured you, how could you end up like this!"

"I regret it too!" Wang Qiang said cruelly: "You are beautiful. When you fell down just now, Divine Doctor Li couldn't take his eyes away. If you are willing to serve him, he will definitely forgive me!"

"Wang Qiang! What are you talking about? You are still not a man, and you asked me to serve other men! If I had known you liked being a green turtle so much, I should have gone out to find the young man!"

Cao Ping's face was red with anger, and her eyes were filled with spring water. She was thirty years old, but she still had a delicate charm. Looking at such a beautiful and moist wife, Wang Qiang couldn't bear to part with her, but for the happiness of the rest of his life and the inheritance of the family line, he had no choice but to risk her life!

"Good wife, just serve Dr. Li once. He is young and handsome, and you won't suffer any loss!"

Cao Ping glanced at Li Dazhuang, who was talking to his mother and sister. He was indeed tall and handsome, especially his thick arms, which looked exciting at first sight!

Even though she was so far away, Cao Ping seemed to be able to feel the overbearing and powerful male hormones in his body. Her desire, which had never been satisfied, was rising uncontrollably, and her plump body was also a little hot...

"Okay? Wife?" Wang Qiang asked pleadingly.

Cao Ping's face turned redder, but this time she was not angry, but coquettish!

She looked at Li Dazhuang's figure and finally nodded...

Li Dazhuang didn't take them seriously at all, and didn't care what they were discussing. He just asked with concern whether his mother and Sister Qiu Shuang were scared.
